_doc: Golden vectors for spec/SUBSCRIPTIONS.md (multi-address store, alerts and main screen, steps 1-4). Stores are compared as plain maps after toMap: every item map has all nine fields, address maps all six. 'addressKey' is settlementId|StreetKey|HouseKey, identical to the 1.4.0 key of ledger_*, repair_*, ids_* and emergency alert keys. 'fanout' (section 8): alert specs are given as engine text times; the AlertSpec key is planned_<spanStart>; 'pending' lists the pending members of each expected group, in order, for a fired registry holding 'notified'. 'main' (section 9): switcherItems and viewItem give item ids.
